Separate so the core/format guard stays DOM-free. `paths` maps the plugin's self-reference (`import { Effect } from "@particlr/runtime"`, D7 amendment) to source: without it tsc resolves the bare specifier through package.json `exports` to dist/index.d.ts, a SEPARATE nominal declaration of `Effect` from the one src/phaser imports elsewhere as a type, and structurally-private-member classes fail assignability across the two. Does not affect the JS emitted by tsconfig.build-phaser.json — `paths` only steers type resolution, the bare specifier is written to dist unchanged.
